fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Enabling registers webhook subscriptions with Shopify. Disabling removes them.

fields.label: Shop Domain
fields.description: e.g. my-shop.myshopify.com

fields.label: API Version
fields.description: Pinned Shopify Admin API version, e.g. 2026-01. Shopify releases quarterly and sunsets a version after 12 months.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: From your app in the Shopify Dev Dashboard. Legacy custom apps, which merchants can no longer create, did not use this.

fields.label: Admin API Access Token
fields.description: Filled in automatically by Install with Shopify. Only paste one by hand if you have a legacy custom app token.

fields.label: Client Secret / API Secret Key
fields.description: From the Dev Dashboard app. Used both to exchange the OAuth code for a token and to verify the HMAC on every incoming webhook.

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: The store's presentment currency. If it differs from the Company currency, documents carry a conversion rate.

fields.label: Default Customer
fields.description: Fallback for guest checkouts.

fields.label: Customer Group
fields.description: Group new Shopify customers land in. Leave blank to use Individual. Group-type nodes are not offered: ERPNext refuses them on a Customer.

fields.label: Cash / Bank Account
fields.description: Payment Entries for paid Shopify orders are booked against this account.

fields.label: Shipping Item
fields.description: Used when shipping is booked as a line item rather than a charge.

fields.label: Let ERPNext Overwrite Shopify Titles and Descriptions
fields.description: Off by default, and think hard before turning it on. Shopify holds your storefront copy -- the title a customer reads, the description someone wrote for the product page. With this on, any edit to the Item in ERPNext replaces both with ERPNext's plain values, including an edit to something unrelated like a weight.

fields.label: Publish New Items to Shopify
fields.description: Create Shopify products for ERPNext items ticked 'Publish to Shopify'. Both have to be on, so nothing reaches a live shop by accident.

fields.label: Sync Fulfilments to Shopify
fields.description: Mark orders fulfilled in Shopify when you submit a Delivery Note, and attach carrier and tracking when you submit a Shipment for it. Off by default: it emails your customers.

fields.label: Email Customer on Fulfilment
fields.description: Let Shopify send its dispatch email. Leave off while importing a backlog of orders that already shipped, or every one of those customers hears from you again.

fields.label: Create Missing Items
fields.description: Create an ERPNext Item when an order arrives for an unknown SKU.

fields.label: Default HSN/SAC Code
fields.description: India only. Six or eight digits. Given to items this app creates, which Shopify has no HSN for. Without it, india_compliance refuses to save the item and the whole catalogue import fails. An item that already has a code keeps it, always.

fields.label: Installed On
fields.description: When the OAuth install completed and a token was stored.

fields.label: Granted Scopes
fields.description: What Shopify actually granted. A merchant can approve fewer scopes than requested.

fields.label: Daily Reconciliation
fields.description: Runs a drift check every night, repairing anything webhooks dropped.

fields.label: Webhook Callback URL
fields.description: The endpoint Shopify posts to. Registered automatically; shown for support.
